citations.quote: Andy Matthews, Nevada’s State Controller and Republican candidate for reelection, has endorsed Cody K Whipple for Congress in Nevada’s 4th Congressional District
I’m proud to endorse Cody because I believe he will bring a strong Nevada voice to Congress

notes: Campaign press release quoting the State Controller; not listed on the campaign endorsements page. No announcement by the endorser was found on the hosts reachable from the research environment.
